content:
Following yesterday's release of the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple has now also begun rolling out the public beta. Here are the details.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is available for download starting today

Last week, Apple announced it would skip the testing cycle for macOS 27.1 and go straight to releasing the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. The company then followed up yesterday by releasing the second developer beta.

This adjustment appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will ship with iOS 27.1 pre-installed when it launches on October 23. iOS 27.1 will most likely focus primarily on features and changes to accommodate the new foldable device, which is why Apple is jumping its other operating systems' testing straight to version 27.2.

As for what's currently included in the macOS 27.2 beta, the most notable addition is the expanded language support for Siri AI, as Apple had promised to deliver in October. As of the second beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.

The build number for macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

If you'd like to join Apple's free public beta programme, you can sign up at beta.apple.com.
